verified.entry_point: CLI install/update/reinstall of a dependency -> LibraryInstaller install/update/ensureBinariesPresence -> BinaryInstaller::installBinaries / ensureBinariesExecutable; FileDownloader::install / ensureBinariesExecutable (single-file & path-repository installs). Tests drive these public library methods directly, the established project test idiom.
verified.routes: no true pattern-B upstream routes (screener O8 empty); the two extra sinks are injected siblings (see traps S1,S2)
verified.project_tests_run: tests/Composer/Test/Installer/BinaryInstallerTest.php (4), tests/Composer/Test/Downloader/FileDownloaderTest.php (9) pass at the pinned+injection commit; upstream regression tests for this advisory are NOT present at the pinned commit

wrong_fix_catalogue.refuse_all: n/a: a deny-everything fix on the bin path fails the legitimate-install functional tests (they assert a proxy/exec result); the nearest over-block is ff-overbroad.patch (functional_fail)
wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: a crash on a legitimate bin fails the functional installs, which assert success, and score.py counts errors as failures
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protection concerns one file (the declared bin's real target); there is no neighbouring/proxy resource that could be authorised instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the guarded operation is a permission change (a write); there is no read-vs-write split to get half-right
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no external authority returns a secret/role here; the only fail-closed case (an unresolvable path) is handled by the containment helper

traps.shape: base flaw, report-led (Pattern A): an in-package bin that is a link resolving outside the package is chmod'd/proxied
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the obvious landing point the report leads to

traps.shape: input-shape variant (Pattern A): a '..' metadata string reaching the installer without the solver-time check (reinstall built from installed.json)
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a solver believes the lexical '..' validator already rejects this shape and misses the no-validation reinstall route

traps.shape: far site (Pattern A): the single-file downloader chmods a package's bins itself, in a lower layer
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a different download layer that only ever handles single non-archive files, which 'cannot be symlinks', and whose '..' bins look already rejected

traps.shape: injected sibling: a standalone installer method that re-applies the executable bit without the containment check
traps.realistic_because: a plausible maintainer-added refresh helper; a solver assumes the presence/refresh path merely delegates to the guarded installer

traps.shape: injected sibling: a standalone downloader method that re-applies the executable bit, used on path-repository installs
traps.realistic_because: a copyable exec-bit repair loop; a solver dismisses it as a local, trusted path-repository source where symlinks are expected
